This study offers a cartographic representation of the levels of mobile coverage in the population centers of Castilla y León. Coverage: ES. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
